proof_core: If n is even, y=x-(n/2)k has 2y=0 and gives a section, so L≅Z⊕C2.
If n is odd, y=x+((1-n)/2)k has 2y=k; then y generates L, so L≅Z and K=2L.
classification_theorem.statement: Choose a metatheoretic generator k of K and any x with p(x)=z. Write 2x=nk. The class epsilon=n mod 2 is independent of the lift; changing k to -k changes n to -n and hence preserves epsilon. epsilon completely classifies the extension up to isomorphism commuting with p.

equivalent_nonsplit_criteria: TurnLift has no element of order two lying above z
there exists x with p(x)=z and 2x in Gen(ker p)

extension_classes.implication: This is an explicit S6 countermodel to 'S6 forces a half-lift whose double generates the kernel'.
extension_classes.witness: Every odd-coset lift (a,1) doubles to (2a,0), never a kernel generator (±1,0).

extension_classes.double_image: ±1 double to ±2, the two raw generators of K.
extension_classes.primitive_half_lifts: Exactly +1 and -1 in the normal form; abstractly an inverse pair.

minimal_extension_debt.why_minimal: The frozen S6 model class contains exactly two extension isomorphism classes distinguished by one parity bit; the bridge property is true in exactly one class.

raw_canonicity.orientation_free_half_lift_class: CANONICAL singleton after quotient by inversion.
raw_canonicity.primitive_half_lift: NOT_CANONICAL; inversion x->-x exchanges the two.

setting: Abelian exact sequence 0 -> K -> L --p--> C2 -> 0 with K infinite cyclic, exactly the group-cover content relevant to frozen S6.
